contract.provides: Two separate ROOT models give a conditional renewable pre-conversion barrier and a staged two-frequency capture/activation route. They preserve full-history stocks, leakage and finite capture-basin limits. Neither model constructs a compatible formulation, actual particle-to-product lock or useful opaque-housing manufacturing service. The chemical model assumes ideal scavenging/replenishment and phenomenological conversion. The force model assumes isolated homogeneous spheres, small-particle linear incident acoustics, overdamped one-dimensional motion and cross-frequency averaging. No favorable property transfers between them.

ROOT REMOTE ACOUSTIC WRITING AND RENEWABLE CHEMICAL CONTRAST
14 November 2026 Brisbane / 13 November UTC
Scope: introduced nonliving-material mechanism contracts, not qualified hardware.

The useful operation under investigation is externally writing a useful internal
feature in an optically opaque, nonliving housing: for example a supported rib
or modified flow passage, while preserving a neighbouring passage and recovering
unused feed. Generating a field pattern is only one operation. Access for resin,
removal of unwanted material, a retained product, chemical contrast over the
whole write history, and a witness of final useful function must also exist.
No sealed-housing repair, new resin, manufacturing advantage or prototype is
supplied here.

1. Actual primary constructions and their boundaries

A. US20200001533A1, Methods and systems for additive manufacturing:
https://patents.google.com/patent/US20200001533A1/en
Actual selected description at lines316--406,666--729,759--795 read. It discloses
field-addressed consolidation/trapping, chamber fill and excess removal,
supports, successive processing, acoustic coupling liquid and localized thermal
curing. Its numerical example couples simulated acoustic absorption to heat
transfer. These are prior disclosures, including paid downstream processing;
they are not measured functional parts, cavitation kinetics, reusable material
contrast, a through-wall machine or a legal novelty conclusion. Numerical input
properties from that simulation are not fitted into the new model. Drawings,
PDF, cited originals and other patent-family versions were not followed.

of polymers and composites:
https://patents.google.com/patent/US12358212B2/en

and material-flexibility statements do not establish a matched whole-service

ROOT ACOUSTIC CAPTURE AND ACTIVATION OWNERSHIP CONTRACTS
14 November 2026 Brisbane / 13 November UTC
Nonliving-material research. Introduced model; no constructed manufacturing service.

The concrete operation investigated here is delivering and retaining a small
piece of material at an internal address until a separate material-locking
operation can take ownership. Supplying nonreactive feed only where needed is
a different possible representation from exposing an entire reactive bath.
It does not supply a bond, useful shape, clean empty passage or renewable stock.

A trapping field and an activating field have different physical jobs. A
pressure pattern that can activate chemistry need not retain a particle at
that same location. This note constructs a conditional two-frequency and
time-ordered capture route in an isolated-sphere model, and keeps the missing
particle-to-product transition explicit.

1. Actually read governing primary construction

Settnes--Bruus2012, Forces acting on a small particle in an acoustical field in
a viscous fluid, DOI10.1103/PhysRevE.85.016327:
https://bruus-lab.dk/TMF/publications/pub2011/Settnes_rad_force_visc_PRE_85_016327_2012.pdf

Actual selected main370--868/pp3--6 was read, including the standing-wave
potential(20), monopole coefficient(26), viscous dipole coefficient(39) and
near/far-field matching conditions. The construction treats a small spherical
particle and a thin acoustic boundary layer relative to wavelength, with
perturbative linear incident acoustics and second-order radiation force.
It distinguishes gradient standing-wave force from travelling-wave force.
This is established theory, not a new radiation-force derivation or a measured
material point. FIRST further governing open868 returned400Timeout. The SAME
